structural_findings.finding: FTS5 quoted-phrase defect: sentence queries reached search_symbols as ONE quoted MATCH phrase, so the BM25 leg was empty 29/29 with enrich off -- RRF fused [empty, dense] and every fusion knob measured noise (the task's own T012 order warning realized).

Cross-encoder flattening: with rerank on, fused order is byte-identical 29/29 across k{1,10,60} x weights{(2,1),(1,2),(3,1),(1,3)} x topN{10,20}; under enrich ON always-fused (0.6231/0.5172) beats always-rerank (0.5713/0.4101) -- the reranker MASKS upstream lever gains.

Rerank masking of enrichment: at ~40x p95 the stage is strictly worse on BOTH metrics with enrich on (T017 rows: enrich rr-on 0.5952/0.4106 vs rr-off 0.6337/0.4808); marginal value at the shipped flat config is only +0.0017 recall / +0.0093 MRR (T019 stage 3).

Structured-pair MRR cost: T016's importance-ordered structured pair cost -0.1045 MRR vs flat on identical pools (0.3399 vs 0.4444) -- structured default REVERTED to flat; construction tests pin the choice.
Corpus-recipe signal: C_TRIM won tune (+0.0931) and the dropout axis was inert (parameters/return_type empty 1066/1066), but validate could not confirm (p=0.579) -- default stays B.

verdict.honesty_clause: if the sweep cannot reach the margin without violating the protected baselines or the precision doctrine, the best evidenced configuration ships and the shortfall is documented in the ablation table -- never gamed (spec.md SC-1)
verdict.statement: SC-1 (recall@10 >= 0.50, MRR >= 0.33) was NOT reached: the shipped configuration is unchanged at full-set 0.4174/0.2862 (margins -0.0826 recall / -0.0438 MRR). Five confirmation-ladder candidates beat the incumbent on tune -- up to C_TRIM x enrich x rerank-on at 0.6989 tune recall (+0.1161) -- but ALL FIVE failed the held-out paired-bootstrap guard on the 29-query validate split (best: B x enrich x rerank-off, delta +0.1123, p=0.118). The binding constraint is the ground truth, not the levers: at n=29 every bootstrap CI straddles zero (widths ~+/-0.13-0.15), so no true improvement of this size can clear 95% on DS-v1. The honest conclusion: a DS-v2 with substantially more L1 queries is the unlock, and the enrich+rerank-off direction -- the only direction every near-miss points to -- is its first candidate. Match rules were never loosened; nothing shipped unverified.
what_would_clear_the_bar: DS-v2 with more L1 queries: at n=29 the bootstrap CIs are +/-0.13-0.15 -- a +0.11 true delta needs roughly 2-3x the validate queries to clear 95%
first candidate for DS-v2: enrich + rerank-off (B or C_TRIM) -- the only direction with consistent tune AND validate point estimates across T011/T015/T017/T019
re-test enrichment after any corpus-recipe change (T012's order dependency): the sparse leg only contributes under enrich-on, which is where fusion knobs stop being inert

shipped_defaults.statement: NO SHIP: the incumbent all-levers-off remains the shipped default configuration (config_reference unchanged). No v2 row ships: the three guard-clearing candidates all fail zero-shot DS-v2 transfer (see verdict). Because nothing ships, no protected baseline is re-measured in this campaign (the re-measure obligation binds the ship branch only); the committed baselines (perf search_symbols p95 6.25 / semantic_search 201.67 / explore 453.18/513.73 / impact 0.11; agent est_tokens 6848; warm_time cold 15497.2 / warm 232.6 / 66.6x) remain the protected figures of record.

task: T022 (FR-006); skeleton -- measurement rows land with T023 (ds-v2) and T024 (ds-v1-kfold)

best_candidate_record.disposition: guard-cleared on DS-v1, refuted zero-shot — not shipped; recorded as the campaign's best candidate with both intervals

ds2_counts.note: filled by T023 from the sealed dataset (T009/T010 loader counts); floors met: 154 >= 150 L1, 44 >= 40 L5

verdict.evidence_base: 5-fold seeded rotation over the 58 DS-v1 L1 queries (pooled per-query paired bootstrap at n=58, per-fold spread descriptive only) PLUS zero-shot DS-v2 validation over both corpora (154 L1 / 44 L5 queries; per-corpus rows + macro-average in the ds-v2 family) — never the legacy single split (TC-029)
verdict.honesty_clause: same clause as the v1 record: if the sweep cannot reach the margin without violating the protected baselines or the precision doctrine, the best evidenced configuration ships and the shortfall is documented in this document -- never gamed (spec.md SC-1)
verdict.l5_note: The 44 DS-v2 L5 queries were evaluated through the same seam and score 0.0 for every configuration: L5 retrieval is OKF bundle search (no retrieval tunables), and the benchmark corpora carry no .knowledge/ bundle — the same recorded-as-structural-zero discipline as the committed DS-v1 quality baseline ('surface absent', benchmarks/baselines/DS-v1/README.md). Never blended into the L1 rows.

margins.basis: per-family actual minus target, per metric; the full-evidence outcome is governed by the weaker leg

armed_experiments: T014's diagnostic, already in the record: the enrichment cutoff's real DS-v1 threshold is ~0.27 ('url' prevalence 0.2711), not 0.90 — a 0.25-0.30 cutoff band is the concrete untested knob for the enrich direction (d03-diagnostic.json showed L1-D03 recovering at cutoff 0.25, rank 6)

multivector's corpus-dependence: the name/docstring max-score union over-fits yarl's docstring style — a name-kind-only ablation or a DS-v2-era calibration (tune on DS-v2, validate on DS-v1) would isolate which vector kind carries the non-transferring gain

the rerank MRR finding is corpus-dependent too (v1: rerank costs 7-9pp MRR on DS-v1; DS-v2 zero-shot: the incumbent's rerank-active MRR is +2.2pp over rerank-off) — any rerank-off default proposal needs both corpora's evidence
next_binding_constraint.constraint: cross-corpus / query-population generalization of the levers — not evidence power
next_binding_constraint.evidence: the v1 campaign's binding constraint (evidence power) was fixed: n=58 pooling converted the p=0.118 near-miss into three guard-clearing candidates. The v2 constraint is that every candidate's DS-v1 gain fails to transfer zero-shot (mv harms, enrich nulls), so no DS-v1-tuned lever can ship as a global default on this evidence

per_fold_spread.note: descriptive only, never the significance basis (D-009); all five folds positive — the DS-v1 leg leaves; the zero-shot leg lives in the ds-v2 rows

sc1_actual.basis: SC-1 is evaluated on the full upgraded evidence base (DS-v1 k-fold pooled + DS-v2 zero-shot), per family — never a single-leg figure presented alone. The DS-v1 leg reached both targets via multivector (0.5588/0.3395); that configuration is refuted zero-shot (DS-v2 macro 0.4632/0.2844, MRR -0.0925 vs the incumbent). The DS-v2 leg reaches neither target for any configuration (best recall macro 0.4778 < 0.50; the 0.3769 MRR figure belongs to that same recall-short incumbent row).

ds_v2_macro_best.note: the incumbent carries the best DS-v2 macro-average of every measured configuration — no candidate improves on it zero-shot

verdict.statement: CLOSED (T024, document branch — exactly one branch taken): NO SHIP; defaults unchanged (the incumbent all-levers-off remains the shipped configuration). Three candidates cleared the DS-v1 pooled bootstrap guard — (a)/(b) enrich+rerank-off delta+0.0988 p=0.0491 CI[+0.0037,+0.2006], (c) multivector delta+0.1414 p=0.0035 CI[+0.0527,+0.2373] — but the zero-shot DS-v2 leg, the generalization check this campaign built, refutes transfer for all of them: multivector REVERSES on the unseen corpus (attrs delta-0.0432 CI[-0.1017,+0.0157] p=0.15; macro MRR -0.0925) and enrich+rerank-off's +9.9pp recall collapses to +0.0003 macro with -0.0215 MRR (per-corpus bootstraps n.s.; on DS-v2's new yarl queries delta-0.0122 — a query-population effect, not only a corpus effect). Under the honesty clause the best evidenced configuration on the FULL evidence base is the incumbent — it carries the best DS-v2 macro of every measured configuration (0.4778/0.3769) and reproduces the committed DS-v1 baseline exactly — so the incumbent ships and the shortfall is documented, never gamed. SC-1 (0.50/0.33, unchanged) is NOT reached on the full evidence base: reached on the DS-v1 leg alone by multivector (0.5588/0.3395) but refuted zero-shot; the DS-v2 leg reaches neither target for any configuration.
